threads.body: `connectionInfo` is a `VirtualField` handle (constant-like) but is named lowerCamelCase. In this codebase, `VirtualField` handles are treated as constants and use `SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE` (e.g., `REQUEST_CONTEXT` etc.). Rename this field accordingly to match the established convention.

threads.body: `connectionInfo(Connection)` and `setConnectionInfo(...)` are `public` but appear to be used only within the `jedis.v4_0` package. Consider reducing their visibility (e.g., package-private) to avoid exposing internal connection metadata plumbing as part of the module’s public surface area.

threads.body: `JedisRequest` now stores the raw `connection` as an AutoValue property, but it is not used anywhere after construction (no call sites of `getConnection()` in this module). Keeping it increases object retention and memory pressure for each request span. Consider removing the connection property from `JedisRequest` and using the local `connection` parameter only to look up `JedisConnectionInfo` during `create(...)`.
